message.text: There are three DB dialect schemas, so I should note the primary one, likely sqlite as the default driver, while mentioning the others exist.

q23.

- SQL schema: `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql` (the `CREATE TABLE memo` at line 33; the same table is mirrored per driver in `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql` line 32 and `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql` line 32)
- Go store model: `store/memo.go` (`type Memo struct`, line 35)
- API proto message: `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` (`message Memo`, line 198)
- Generated frontend types: `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts` (`export type Memo`, line 79)

Two related notes: the store model's `Payload` field points at a second store-level proto, `proto/store/memo.proto` (`MemoPayload`), which is what gets serialized into the `payload` column. And because migrations are per-dialect, the SQL layer genuinely has three files rather than one — `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql` is the one matching the default SQLite driver.
